resources.string: Test AI models in this group

Nothing runs automatically. Tap Start to send a short message (up to 32 output tokens) to each model, one at a time. API usage may consume credits or incur charges. No conversation or API key is sent to other providers.
Testing the first %1$d of %2$d models. Split large groups to test more.
Results help prioritize working models during automatic fallback for up to 10 minutes. All configured models remain eligible. Tests never start in the background.
